2019 Q1.gq: We started the year with good results allowing us to raise guidance for the full year.

2019 Q4.bq: For the full year, adjusted EBITDA margin was 39.8%, up about 70 basis points and slightly better than the high end of our guidance provided in October.

2020 Q1.bq: Despite the sea change in economic activity that began in the second half of March, the strength of the first two and a half months of the first quarter resulted in revenue and adjusted EPS for TransUnion above the high end of our guidance and adjusted EBITDA in the middle of the range.

2020 Q4.bq: We delivered solid results at the high end of our guidance as we benefited from gradual improvement across almost all of our markets, as well as the strength and diversity of our portfolio.

2021 Q1.gq: And that's what we're going to do again this quarter by raising full year guidance based on a more constructive view of our markets supported by concrete, macro indicators, and clear signal from our customers.

2021 Q2.gq: Adjusted diluted earnings per share are expected to be between $0.91 and $0.93, an increase of 12% to 15%.

2021 Q3.gq: And as our outlook for the year has further improved, we raised our outlook for the full year for the third consecutive quarter.

2025 Q2.gq: As Chris mentioned, we are raising our guidance for the full year primarily to account for strong first-half results as well as continued business momentum.
2025 Q2.bq: Adjusted diluted earnings per share was $1.08, $0.9 ahead of the high end of our guidance and an increase of 9%.

2025 Q3.gq: Turning to guidance, As Chris mentioned, we are raising our full-year outlook reflecting strong third-quarter results, stable U.S. lending conditions, and new business wins.
2025 Q3.bq: Adjusted diluted earnings per share was $1.10, 6% ahead of the high end of our guidance and an increase of 6%.

2025 Q4.gq: Revenue is guided to be between $1.195 billion and $1.205 billion, 8% to 9% on an organic constant currency basis or 5% to 6% excluding the impact from FICO mortgage royalties.
2025 Q4.bq: Adjusted diluted earnings per share was $1.07, $0.05 ahead of the high end of our guidance and an increase of 10%.

2026 Q1.gq: We've raised our guidance based on our recent acquisitions and anticipate a strong year.
2026 Q1.bq: Excluding FICO mortgage royalties, revenue grew 7% and which is also above our expectations.

2026 Q3.bq: Starting with the quarter, revenue and adjusted EBITDA exceeded the high end of guidance by $3 million and $2 million respectively.
